title: obc-pack config
description: Configuration for the obc-pack map packer (.osm.pbf -> .obcm). Feature styling is an ordered map: style IDs are assigned 1-based in document order (at most 254 styles), and a way is styled by the first (tag_key, value) match in that order. The packer ignores unknown keys at the root and inside style objects, so tooling metadata (`_meta`, `disabled`) can ride along and any exported file doubles as a CLI config.

features.description: OSM tag_key -> value -> style. Document order is load-bearing: it assigns style IDs and first-match wins.

lods.description: LOD pyramid, coarsest tier first. Absent or empty means a single coarsest layer.

marker.description: User-position marker; the shape is fixed in firmware, only the color is configurable.

chunk_size.description: Quadtree chunk payload target in bytes. The maximum is the reader's per-feature vertex cap; larger values are rejected at pack time.

color.description: RGB565 as a `0x`-prefixed hex string (1-4 digits) or an integer 0..=65535. Pick values on the panel's RGB222 grid (4 levels per channel) so the editor and the glass agree.

max_mpp.description: Meters-per-pixel upper bound for this tier; null means the coarsest (overview) tier.

simplify.description: Topology-preserving simplify tolerance in meters; 0 means no simplification.

style.description: One feature style. `id` is never configured - it is assigned from document order.

z_index.description: Painter's order; lower is drawn first.

priority.description: Chunk-overflow drop order: 1 is kept longest, 4 dropped first.

min_lod.description: Index of the coarsest LOD tier that includes this feature; it appears in every tier >= min_lod (0 = visible from the overview tier).
